highlightSections.title: 银海官网航线摘要
highlightSections.content: This extraordinary expedition to the extreme south begins with luxurious sea days. The anticipation builds until you’re immersed in the wild beauty of South Georgia, kayaking icy channels, cruising wildlife-rich frozen shores, and hiking rocky beaches. Reach Antarctica to discover bustling penguin colonies and whale pods, as you navigate iceberg-strewn waters. Soak it in as enchanting landscapes of creeping glaciers and snow-covered mountain peaks swallow you up.

shipDetail.name: Silver Cloud 银海迎云号
shipDetail.intro: Silver Cloud is the first crossover ship in our fleet, bringing the remote and remarkable to you in ultra-luxurious comfort. Her large suites, destination itineraries and unparalleled service make her truly special. Four dining options will tantalise your taste buds, and as 80% of her suites include a veranda, watching a breaching whale from the comfort of your balcony never been so personal. With her 20 zodiacs, 10 kayaks, possibilities are almost limitless with ship-wide simultaneous explorations. Ship Details :
